items.model: Ðū eart dūst, and ðū gewęntst tō dūste.
Swā swīðe lufode God middangeard, ðæt hē sealde his āncęnnedan Sunu, ðæt nān ne forweorðe ðe on hine gelīefð, ac hæbbe ðæt ēce līf.
Sē Hǣlend cwæð tō him, Ic eom weg and sōðfæstnes and līf; nān ne cymð tō ðǣm Fæder būtan ðurh mē.
Sibbe ic forlǣte ēow; mīne sibbe ic forgiefe ēow.
Ðā rīnde, and ðǣr cōmon flōdas, and blēowon windas, and āhruron on ðæt hūs; and ðæt hūs feoll.
Swā ǣlc gōd trēo bereð gōde wæstmas, and ǣlc yfel trēo bereð yfle wæstmas.
Ǣlc trēo ðe gōdne wæstm ne bereð bið forcorfen and on fȳr worpen.
Hē ēode on munt, ðæt hē hine gebǣde; and ðā hē hine gebæd, wæs his rēaf hwīt, scīnende.
Se munt, hrēosende, weorðeð tō nāhte.
Se cyning on eallum his wuldre næs geglęnged swā ān ðissa.
Hē ætīewde him his dēorwierðu ðing, ðæt seolfor and ðæt gold and ðā wyrtgemang and eall ðæt on his goldhordum gemētt wæs.
Sum welig mann wæs mid gōdwębbe geglęnged.
Ðā læg sum wǣdla æt his geate.
Nān mann him ne sealde; ac hundas cōmon and liccodon his wunda.
Ðā gelamp ðæt se wǣdla gewāt; and ęnglas bǣron hine tō Abrahames wīce.
Ðā āhōf hē his ēagan ūp and geseah Abraham feorran.
Ēalā fæder Abraham, gemiltsa mē, and sęnd Lazarum.
Ēalā sunu, gemun ðæt ðū onfēnge gōdum on ðīnum līfe.
Ic bidde ðē ðæt ðū hine tō mīnes fæder hūse sęnde.
Gif hīe ðā wītgan ne hīerað, ne gelīefað hīe, ðēah hwā of dēaðe ārīse.
Tiliað ēow frēonda on Godes ðearfum. Gē habbað manige Lazaras nū licgende æt ēowrum geatum.
